label: 話しかけている男の子
prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve character asset. Reference image is a visual reference for character identity, costume, pose and painterly style, NOT a background to reproduce. Create ONE isolated character cutout asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha); no colored paper, no white rectangle, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no speech balloon, no calendar, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Match the attached Japanese children's book illustration closely: warm watercolor/gouache texture, fine soft dark-brown outlines, gentle natural proportions, expressive brown eyes, delicate shading, not glossy 3D and not anime redesign. Keep one consistent character identity. Girl: chestnut bob hair, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan with small buttons, cream shirt, teal pleated skirt. Boy: tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie over cream shirt. Final square 1536x1536 composition, character large with a small clear transparent margin around the entire subject. Never crop head, hair, fingers or required objects. Recreate ONLY the speaking boy at the LEFT foreground. Waist-up, positioned to face SCREEN RIGHT toward a listener that will be placed separately. Friendly engaged expression, mouth open speaking, brown eyes looking RIGHT, one hand open palm-up gesturing RIGHT. Tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie with cream drawstrings, cream shirt. Full hair, head, upper body and complete fingers visible; intentional waist/hip crop only along lower edge of figure. ONE boy alone. No girl, pony, park, words or speech balloon.
